mapper.select: select vbi.id, vbi.procurement_plan_type as expenditure_business_type, vbi.vendor_id, tv.enterprise_name as vendor_name, vbi.taxpayer as party_a_org_id, vbi.project_code as min_account_code, tmp.project_department_id, sd.dept_name as party_a_name, ta.contract_amount, tv.enterprise_province_code, tv.enterprise_city_code, CONCAT(COALESCE(tv.enterprise_province_name, ''), '-', COALESCE(tv.enterprise_city_name, '')) AS enterprise_location, vbi.tbi_count, vbi.tbr_count , vbi.tbr_amount , vbi.tbr_rate , vbi.apply_time, concat('合格', ifnull(vec.qualified_count, 0), '次，不合格', ifnull(vec.unqualified_count, 0), '次') as evaluation_type_name, ifnull(vec.qualified_count, 0) as qualified_count, ifnull(vec.unqualified_count, 0) as unqualified_count from v_bidding_info vbi left join tb_vendor tv on vbi.vendor_id = tv.id left join tb_min_project tmp on vbi.project_code = tmp.min_account_code left join sys_dept sd on sd.thrid_dept_id = vbi.taxpayer left join ( select concat(ta.expenditure_business_type,'-',ta.belong_accounting_item_code,'-',ta.vendor_id,'-',ta.party_a_org_id) as id, SUM(ta.total_amount_inc_tax) AS contract_amount FROM tb_agreement ta GROUP BY ta.expenditure_business_type,ta.vendor_id,ta.party_a_org_id,ta.belong_accounting_item_code ) ta on vbi.id COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci = ta.id COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci left join ( select ve.vendor_id, sum(case when ve.is_qualified = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end) as qualified_count, sum(case when ve.is_qualified = 'N' then 1 else 0 end) as unqualified_count from tb_vendor_evaluate ve where ve.del_flag = '0' and ve.evaluate_status = '1' group by ve.vendor_id ) vec on vec.vendor_id = vbi.vendor_id
